(Dogecoin)](https://www.coindesk.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.sanity.io%2Fimages%2Fs3y3vcno%2Fproduction%2F2af70fa2f5209029fd0a8f7ac7524c5b60b2ba81-1920x1080.png%3Fw%3D1920%26h%3D1080%26auto%3Dformat&w=3840&q=75) Dogecoin gets DeFi testnet as DogeOS bets miners will eventually secure its apps. (Dogecoin) Summary * DogeOS opened a public test network that lets developers build Ethereum-compatible trading, lending and stablecoin applications using test DOGE. * The network initially relies on selected operators, protected hardware and a Security Council, while a proposed Dogecoin Core upgrade would eventually allow Dogecoin miners to verify its proofs. * DogeOS has not set a mainnet launch date and faces questions about demand after weak Dogecoin ETF inflows and the decline of earlier memecoin application networks. DogeOS has opened a public test network for Ethereum-style trading, lending and other applications using DOGE, an attempt to give Dogecoin holders more ways to use their coins beyond payments and price speculation. Per documents shared with CoinDesk, the network launched Wednesday and is Ethereum-compatible, meaning it allows developers to use familiar software to build applications. The trial uses test DOGE to pay transaction fees, with projects developing lending services, trading platforms and a cryptocurrency-backed stablecoin. ## Why dogecoin?
